titleEn: eSIM for Laos – Off the Beaten Path, Still Online
contentEn:
Travel Laos Without Losing Your Signal

Laos is Southeast Asia's most serene destination – Buddhist temples in Luang Prabang draped in saffron, the mighty Mekong River, and the cascading waterfalls of Kuang Si. Sim2Me's eSIM for Laos ensures you stay connected even in this off-the-beaten-path kingdom.

Why Choose Sim2Me?

  • Coverage on Unitel and Lao Telecom.
  • 4G LTE in Vientiane and Luang Prabang.
  • Activate before your flight – arrive digitally ready.
  • No need to buy a local SIM at Wattay Airport.

Network Performance in Laos

4G LTE in Vientiane and Luang Prabang. 3G along Route 13 (the main north–south highway) and in larger towns. The 4000 Islands (Si Phan Don) area has 3G coverage for messaging and light navigation.

Quick Installation Guide

  • QR code by email.
  • Scan in phone settings.
  • Sabaidee – welcome to Laos, connected!
